classifications.rationale: The President presently sets apart and reserves specified federal lands as a national monument and imposes an off-road vehicle prohibition; those legal consequences arise from the proclamation itself.
classifications.evidence: there are hereby set apart and reserved as the Grand Canyon-Parashant National Monument

classifications.rationale: The provision assigns cooperative and primary management responsibilities to the National Park Service and Bureau of Land Management and directs continued lease administration under existing law and policy; it organizes ongoing agency management rather than itself changing legal rights.
classifications.evidence: The National Park Service and the Bureau of Land Management shall manage the monument cooperatively
